items.Graphene X5: Provides a level of gloss that will blow your mind. This comprehensive super-sealant amplifies the best aspects of ceramics.
items.Ceramic X3: Bonding at a molecular level, the three-step layering process of CERAMIC X3 forms a durable shield that is resistant to dirt, bird droppings, contaminants and water.
items.Fusion Bath: Our Fusion Bath breaks the bond of the most difficult surface contaminants with a specially-formulated low pH detergent. Applied in a thin sheet of foam that envelops the car!
items.Fusion Prime: Lifts embedded road grime to prime painted surfaces for total adhesion of the Fusion Seal. This ultra-low pH detergent is applied in precise streams that penetrate prior foam applications.
items.Fusion Rinse: Breaks down and removes foam residue to expose painted surfaces to the Fusion Seal. The Fusion Rinse is infused into a waterfall rinse that flushes all grooves, crevices, and behind mirrors.
items.Fusion Seal: Our Fusion Seal locks out dirt and protects painted surfaces with a formula that chemically bonds to the surface. The application of overlapping droplets evenly spreads for continuous coverage.
items.Fusion Wax: Enhance the depth and quality of your car’s shine with our poly-synthetic wax blended with genuine carnauba. Fusion Wax is applied in a cascading sheet of airy foam for complete coating.
items.Fusion Rain Repel: Improve all-weather glass visibility with this hydrophobic spray application. Fusion Rain Repel is applied to glass surfaces with precision-targeting.
items.Wheel Bright: Ultimate in real cleaning and brightening results. Restores the new-car shine to your wheels.
items.Undercarriage Wash: Prevents corrosion causing grime from building up under the vehicle with a rinse that gently removes dirt, mud and other road crud.
items.Buff-N-Shine: Eliminates any remaining water droplets and gently buffs the surface to improve the shine of your car.
items.Dry: Our drying agent results in a quickly dried vehicle.
items.Wash: Basic Wash that is fast, easy and convenient.
items.Wheel Cleaner: Breaks down the dirt and grime of everyday road use.
items.Triple Foamer: Three colors of rich foaming polish that enhances the paint’s shine and protection. It contains polymer protection that bonds to the vehicle’s paint and clear coat surface.
items.Presoak: Remove road film and bug residue without scrubbing or scraping.
items.Tire Shine: Produces a high gloss finish to give your tires that new look and feel. Designed to give excellent gloss and leveling properties to tires.
